sync-plugin.name: Synchronous plug-in step
sync-plugin.chooseWhen: a rule must hold for every channel and may need related rows or must cancel the save with a message

client-script.name: Form client script
client-script.chooseWhen: behaviour or validation that only matters while a person works in a form (show, hide, warn, default)

cloud-flow.name: Power Automate cloud flow
cloud-flow.chooseWhen: fixed automation after the fact or on a schedule, with no agent involved, maintained by makers

business-rule.name: Business rule
business-rule.chooseWhen: simple conditions on columns of the same row, without code; Entity scope also runs on the server

virtual-table.name: Virtual table
virtual-table.chooseWhen: an external system of record must appear as a table (views, subgrids) without copying its rows

elastic-table.name: Elastic table
elastic-table.chooseWhen: very high write volume, time to live or partitioned reads, without relational features

standard-table.name: Standard table
standard-table.chooseWhen: Dataverse is the system of record and needs relationships, business rules and full security

connector-action.name: Connector action
connector-action.chooseWhen: you only need to call an external API from a flow or app, not show its data as a table

background-operation.name: Background operation (preview)
background-operation.chooseWhen: a caller must be freed at once from a long custom API call and learn the outcome later (Prefer: respond-async)

async-plugin-step.name: Asynchronous plug-in step
async-plugin-step.chooseWhen: follow-up work after a commit that nobody waits for and that returns nothing to the caller

code-app.name: Code app
code-app.chooseWhen: a standalone pro-code web app (React, TypeScript) on Power Platform hosting with connectors

generative-page.name: Generative page
generative-page.chooseWhen: a page or section inside a model-driven app, described and generated rather than hand-coded

web-resource.name: Web resource
web-resource.chooseWhen: script libraries for forms and commands; not the first choice for new bound UI

pcf.name: Code component (PCF)
pcf.chooseWhen: a reusable visual control bound to a column or a dataset, shipped in a solution

agent-flow.name: Copilot Studio agent flow
agent-flow.chooseWhen: a deterministic tool that an agent calls, billed as Copilot Studio capacity

cs-workflow.name: Copilot Studio workflow (GitHub Copilot harness)
cs-workflow.chooseWhen: agentic multi-step automation with AI actions and agent handoffs

classic-workflow.name: Classic Dataverse workflow
classic-workflow.chooseWhen: only to maintain existing background processes; new automation uses cloud flows

csp-connect-src.name: CSP connect-src
csp-connect-src.chooseWhen: the app must call an origin from the browser (fetch, XHR, WebSocket)

csp-frame-ancestors.name: CSP frame-ancestors
csp-frame-ancestors.chooseWhen: only listed pages may embed the app in a frame

csp-frame-src.name: CSP frame-src
csp-frame-src.chooseWhen: the app itself must show another origin in a frame

plugin-managed-identity.name: Managed identity for plug-ins
plugin-managed-identity.chooseWhen: a plug-in must call an Azure resource without storing a secret (IManagedIdentityService)

secure-config.name: Secure configuration of a step
secure-config.chooseWhen: step settings only some administrators may read; still a stored secret when it holds keys

shared-connection.name: A person's shared connection
shared-connection.chooseWhen: never for unattended automation: actions run as that person

openapi-enum.name: OpenAPI enum
openapi-enum.chooseWhen: a parameter has a small fixed list of values that rarely changes

openapi-summary.name: x-ms-summary
openapi-summary.chooseWhen: a parameter or property needs a friendly label in the designer

dynamic-values.name: x-ms-dynamic-values
dynamic-values.chooseWhen: a parameter's list must come from another operation because the values change

copilot-client-library.name: Copilot Studio client library
copilot-client-library.chooseWhen: your own app must talk to a published Copilot Studio agent for a signed-in user (delegated token)

dataverse-mcp-server.name: Dataverse MCP server
dataverse-mcp-server.chooseWhen: an agent or developer tool needs tools over Dataverse tables, not a conversation with an existing agent

web-chat-embed.name: Web chat embed
web-chat-embed.chooseWhen: a page only needs to show the agent's chat; authentication decides who it acts for

monitor-alert.name: Power Platform Monitor alert
monitor-alert.chooseWhen: daily product-health thresholds on a Managed Environment, with a few recipients

log-search-alert.name: Azure Monitor log search alert
log-search-alert.chooseWhen: a threshold over your own telemetry within minutes, with details from the query

appinsights-export.name: Dataverse export to Application Insights
appinsights-export.chooseWhen: platform telemetry for analysis where a delivery time of up to a day is acceptable

per-item-notification.name: Per-item notification
per-item-notification.chooseWhen: each single failure must reach a person, not a threshold over a window
